# 🧠 JaneBot MotherBrain

The central orchestration hub for the MkdMind AI agent swarm. Designed to run on a tablet as a command-and-control center.

## 🚀 Quick Start

commands: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && python main.py

bard_note: Node project present. Expect npm hell or a pleasant surprise. Has Python deps. Hope they pinned versions. (Bardildo: harsh truth incoming)
